units.source_text: 烧毁我的火，也定会烧毁金阁。

en.t: The fire that burns me to ashes will surely burn down the Golden Pavilion as well.

units.source_text: 这种想法几乎陶醉了我。
在遭受相同灾难、相同不吉利的火的命运中，金阁和我所居住的世界一元化了。

en.t: Within the fate of suffering the same disaster, the same ominous fire, the Golden Pavilion and the world I inhabited became one.

units.source_text: 尽管金阁坚固，却与我的脆弱而丑陋的肉体一样，拥有易燃的碳素的肉体。

en.t: Though the Golden Pavilion was solid, it possessed, just like my fragile and ugly body, a body of carbon that could easily burn.
Thinking of it in this way,

units.source_text: 我似乎可以把金阁藏在我的肉体里，藏在我的组织里，

en.t: I seemed able to hide the Golden Pavilion inside my body, inside my tissues,

units.source_text: 就像潜逃的盗贼把昂贵的宝石咽下，然后隐匿起来似的。

en.t: just as a fleeing thief swallows an expensive jewel and then goes into hiding.
